play_name: Let your real view be known
behavioral_target: Always keeping the peace by hiding how you feel.
trigger: Something bothers you, but speaking up could cause tension.
old_play: You keep the peace and hold your feelings in.
function_of_old_play: Keeping the peace helps you avoid conflict and tension in the moment.
new_play: Say one true thing about how you feel. You do not have to fix it or fight.
what_to_expect: Things may feel tense for a bit. You find out if the calm was real or just quiet.
why_supports_task: Letting your real view be known helps others know you and helps you see if the peace is shared. This work does not sit in one relationship phase.
context_limitations: Keeping the peace is fine at times. This is about when you always do it and hide how you feel. If a home is not safe, staying quiet can be a way to stay safe.
review_reason: Cross-Phase source gap: no competency maps and there is no single developmental task. The maintaining role fits the always-keeping-the-peace pattern in a family context.
